descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
You need to be an excellent Technical Analyst, communicator and feel comfortable interacting with stakeholders at various levels within the client organization in an empathic and considerate way. You must have proven experience in analyzing business needs and translating them into requirements. You must be willing to help us build a new reporting solution across the globe.
 Responsibilities:
Deep understanding of Finance industry and MIS reporting
Deep understanding of products and processes for Private Banking customers, essential for integrating data into MIS and providing a single data source for all stakeholders.
Experience in Functional Analysis , Private Banking, Wealth Management
Experience on database concepts, SQL, Big Query, ETL, BI solutions (Looker, Angular, Tableau), and data analytics, specifically applied to consolidating diverse data sources
Experience working closely with Product Owners and Business Analysts for translating business requirements into technical requirements
Be the key actor in writing & conducting UAT test cases and, in case required, train the stakeholders
Validate requirements, UAT Testing & User Training (if required): you will validate e2e requirements via reviews, walkthroughs, and demo.
Translate business needs by creating models, diagrams, presentations and other documentations that support the target audience to understand the business requirements
Facilitate communication at team level in order to create consensus on scope, design decisions, and implementation decisions
Proactively Identify risks / issues that might affect squad’s overall health
Demonstrates experience in understanding the business process design
Customer and service oriented to support interaction with team resources and clients, actively engages stakeholders to build an understanding of the requirements
 Preferred experience:
Database experience and advanced SQL skills
MIS reporting skills
Experience with AI usage in documentation processes.
Familiarity or experience with integrating AI functionalities into reporting solutions.
 Skills:
Excellent communication and English skills
Can work under pressure and be delivery focused and pragmatic
Excellent team work with collaborative, innovative and intelligent problem solving
Analyze, troubleshoot, document
Actively seeks to reduce complexity and do the “right thing”
Persistent in your drive for quality and excellence
Architecturally minded with an ability to simplify complex activities
Influencer and problem solving person
Ability to identify and interpret stakeholders needs and requirements
Self-motivated and flexibility to work autonomously coupled with ability to work in virtual teams and matrix/global organizations
Performance and productivity oriented to drive toward results
Proactively initiate, develop and maintain effective working relationships with team members, demonstrated ability to cooperate with a variety of people
